design_rules: No random obstacle generator is used at runtime; all obstacle coordinates are explicit in this committed catalog.
World is 100 x 40 m with z in [0.5,6.0] m and a 96 m nominal route.
Four physical boundary walls are shared by all scenes, sensed and collided with like ordinary geometry.
Field obstacle targets are 50 easy, 100 medium and 150 hard obstacles, excluding the four boundary walls.
Obstacles fill the full map width outside a curated feasible route tube rather than clustering near the centerline.
Every scene blocks direct start-goal flight and keeps one offline inspection route with positive clearance.
inspection_path is validation/replay metadata only and is never exposed to PPO, D.VA, EGO-Planner or SUPER.

MIGHTY.used_as_reference_for: ~105m end-to-end navigation and long-corridor dynamic obstacle placement; trefoil-style moving obstacles

SANDO.used_as_reference_for: 100x40m paper benchmark footprint and 105m route; trefoil motion semantics

SUPER.used_as_reference_for: 15x110x6 static/high-speed map scale and physical point-cloud world; boundary visibility is made explicit in P5
